description.value:
You Set a Spotlight on the target that does not move. The creature gains the trendsetter role for the duration of the spell, in addition to their normally assigned role.

The trendsetter can [[/act perform]] to strike a pose and force a creature within 30 feet to attempt a Reflex save against your spell DC. On a failure, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 2 rounds (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical failure), as the target becomes forcefully clad in holographic avant-garde fashion.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.WZTn5onQlTenBGi5]{Effect: Spotlight}

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.vYCY3uEYojvomVFi]{Effect: Role}

Heightened (3rd) The trendsetter can target an additional creature that is under a spotlight.
